// PROBE for tests/unit/advisor-requests-reach-a-visible-advisor.test.ts.
//
// The shape this guard exists to stop: a thread subject typed at the call site,
// in English, which then renders as a heading in a Greek customer's timeline.
// Not compiled — the guard reads it as text.

export async function askAdvisorAboutSomething(policyId: string) {
    const advisors = await resolvePolicyAdvisors(policy)
    const advisor = advisors[0]
    if (!advisor) return { error: "NO_AGENT" }

    await collaborationService.ensureAutomationThread(userId, {
        relationshipId: advisor.relationshipId,
        policyId,
        category: "coverage_gap",
        priority: "high",
        subject: "Coverage gap clarification requested",
        initialMessage: "Policyholder requested help on this coverage gap.",
    })

    return { success: true }
}
